CONTOH EXPRESS DEMO HUB — 2D PLAN v2 (owner changes applied)
Fictional hub, Klang Valley. L-flow: inbound west wall → outbound north wall.
Building 60 x 40 m, eaves 11.0 m. Cross-belt loop on one raised level (1.5 m) + reject chute.
18 cameras (2688x1520, 103.0° HFOV, 10 fps). Cone = floor area at the camera's target
detail (62 PPM observe / 125 recognise); 25 PPM detect reach is in hub_spec.yaml. Cones ignore occlusion; the checks don't.
Red dashed = main parcel flow. Purple dashed = no-read / rework flow. Orange dot = fixed scanner,
yellow dot = handheld scan point. Hatched = BLIND_NW (deliberate, recorded in hub_spec.yaml).
Yellow = walkway; orange band + orange dashed = forklift lane / oversize route; striped = zebra;
grey bridge = crossover (XO); green = fire exit / staff door with lit KELUAR sign.
Labels: synthetic footage of a fictional hub. Generated by assets/hub/build_hub_plan.py.
